{
  "reasoning": "The model was asked to retrieve scores for both a soccer team (Manchester United) and a basketball team (Los Angeles Lakers) in parallel. The evaluation failed because the model made only one tool call instead of two, and used an incorrect function name format.",
  "error_identification": "Turn 0: Model called `basketball_scores_get_scores` (incorrect naming) and omitted `soccer_scores.get_scores` entirely. Turn 1: Model failed to call `basketball_scores.get_scores` when expected. The model made 1 function call instead of the required 2 parallel calls.",
  "root_cause_analysis": "The model appears to have: (1) misformatted the function name using underscore (`basketball_scores_get_scores`) instead of dot notation (`basketball_scores.get_scores`), and (2) failed to recognize that the user request explicitly requires two independent, parallel tool calls—one for each sport/team combination.",
  "correct_approach": "When a user requests data from multiple distinct tool groups in a single query, invoke all relevant functions in parallel with correct dot-notation naming: `soccer_scores.get_scores` for Manchester United (5 rounds) and `basketball_scores.get_scores` for Los Angeles Lakers (7 rounds) simultaneously.",
  "key_insight": "This is a parallel_multiple scenario requiring strict adherence to: (1) correct function naming conventions (dot notation, not underscores), and (2) complete enumeration of all requested tool calls across different tool groups in a single turn."
}

Guidance:
- If the evaluation PASSED, many cases you would return an empty operation list. Propose removals or updates when the current playbook conflicts with the verified behaviour as to need to be updated.
- If the evaluation FAILED, add, modify, or remove bullets narrowly targeted to the failure described in the summary/details.
- Keep updates scoped to the triggering context unless the pattern is clearly systemic.
- Keep content under 160 characters. Return an empty list when no update is needed.

Return JSON with keys "reasoning" (<=2 sentences) and "operations".
